worldcombat.skill.sleeptalk.summary: Usable only while asleep; it randomly performs one of the moves the user has learned.
worldcombat.skill.sleeptalk.use.1: Borrow one known move at random
After mumbling for %1$s it borrows and performs one of its known moves at random; it does not fire when no move is usable.
Sleep Talk reaches %1$s, and the borrowed move cannot reach farther; returning to the dream costs %2$s.
